text: __NOTOC__ The Twilight Apocrypha is a heavy book bound in flesh, written in a pictographic language and undecipherable. However, when the hero finds it near a portal at the bottom of Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal, there are notes and translations tucked within several pages. The hero uses four elemental crucibles near the Apocrypha to control the Eye of Twilight at the entrance of the cave. A Twilight's Hammer cultist called The Manipulator comes through the portal to find who is interfering with the eye just as the hero finishes the ritual of control.
The Twilight Prophet begins by looting the Urgent Twilight Missive inside the Hour of Twilight dungeon.
The Twilight Zone - Guild Edition is criteria for the meta achievement Glory of the Lich King Raider.

The title the Undaunted is awarded to players upon completing the achievement Challenge Conqueror: Bronze by completing every Challenge Mode dungeon with a rating of Bronze or better. It became unobtainable when Season One ended.

The title the Tranquil Master is awarded to players upon completing the achievement Tranquil Master by slaying Sha of Doubt, Sha of Violence, Sha of Anger, Sha of Despair, Sha of Hatred and Sha of Fear.
.]] The Trial of the Red Blossoms is a short novel by Cameron Dayton.
The Underhold is a raid achievement for defeating the bosses at the entrance to Garrosh's secret compound in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
To contribute to this achievement, you must have 3 guild members in the same group to be considered a 'guild group' for scenarios.
The Untamed Valley is a short story by Robert Brooks that is featured on the official site.
The Toymaster is a Collections achievement earned for collecting 150 Toys. It rewards the Robo-Gnomebulator Toy.
Separated from your enemy by two narrow bridges, you might find a Goblin Zeppelin useful in fending off attacks or dropping off a raiding party.

The Traveler's Path, also known as the Song of Liu Lang, refers to the first pandaren explorer. It is sung by Lorewalker Ruolin at the Dawning Span on the Wandering Isle, as well as by Lorewalker Cho at the Wanderer's Festival. The song is the only known example of spoken Pandaren. It is also a music piece featured in the official soundtrack for World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria.
The Trap Game is an achievement earned from completing 50 work orders at the Barn in the garrison.

During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was made available as an item. However, even though the book can still be acquired, the reason of its existence was removed prior to release.
The Twisted Twin can be referring to the following: * Balance: The Twisted Twin * Marksmanship: The Twisted Twin * Frost: The Twisted Twin * Shadow: The Twisted Twin * Affliction: The Twisted Twin
The Twilight Creed is a book found throughout Blackrock Depths.

The Tomb of Sargeras trailer is the official trailer for World of Warcraft Patch 7.2: The Tomb of Sargeras. The trailer shows Archmage Khadgar, the Prophet Velen, and the Armies of Legionfall plotting to deal with the rest of the Burning Legion's forces, as well as Kil'jaeden expressing his doubt to Sargeras concerning the Legion's victory. It also plays as an in-game cinematic upon accepting Assault on Broken Shore (quest).

The Unrelenting is a title obtained by earning Honor Level 80. The title precedes the character's name in the following format: :The Unrelenting Prior to patch 8.0.1, it could have been obtained from Fourteen for the Team.
The Very Best Shirt is contained in Claw-Marked Brawler's Purse.
__NOTOC__ The Tomb Widow is a spider located at the Cursed Landing in Uldum.
The Veiled Threat was a submarine under command of pirate Giras the Guileful. It was taken out by fleets sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
The Total Package is a quest achievement earned by finding the Postmaster in Dalaran and lending him your aid.
The Unbound Force is an Azerite Essence obtained through the reputation factions in Nazjatar. This essence can only be used by DPS specializations.
The Upper Reaches is awarded for completing any run in the Upper Reaches wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The True Maw Walker is a spell cast on the player as a reward for completing Who is the Maw Walker?, part of the Chains of Domination campaign in patch 9.1.
The Unseen Guests Among Us is provided by the Primus for Dread Tidings and Convoy of the Covenants. Deliver it first to Prince Renathal at Dawnkeep in Sinfall, then later to the Stonewright.
The Unknown is a projection of a nightmare dragon located in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ The Unraveller is a devourer located in the Devourered Cache in Zereth Mortis.
The Tragedy of Grrlgllmesh & Eggkidu is obtained from Herodofin.
The Vegetarian Diet is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by freeing every Captive Tuskarr in a Meat Storage in a single visit to Brackenhide Hollow.
__NOTOC__ The Vault is found at the Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach.
The Trouble with Taivan becomes available during the Chasing the Wind chapter of the Ohn'ahran Plains Campaign.
The Titanic Comedy can be found in the Life-Binder Conservatory while on Library of Alexstrasza.

Completing this quest allows the blacksmith to ask for weaponsmithing specialization. You must have at least 200 Blacksmithing skill, and have asked Myolor Sunderfury about weaponsmithing, to be offered this quest.

__NOTOC__ The Windreaver was part of the periodic Elemental Invasions. When he appeared, a zone-wide emote went out, alerting everyone in Silithus he had spawned. He spawned amidst a host of Whirling Invaders and was constantly escorted by some of his guards.
This quest is part of the Barding segment of the quest chain.
The Widow's Embrace drops from Grand Widow Faerlina in Naxxramas.
The Windwatcher is the 1st quest in the The Windwatcher quest chain.
The Warden's Cage sends the player off to find and talk to Sanoru.
The Witch Doctor's Wraps is a quest reward from Have You Ever Seen One of These?.
__NOTOC__ The Willbreaker drops from Keli'dan the Breaker in the Blood Furnace on heroic mode.
The Warp Rifts sends the player to test out an experimental warp rift generator.
The Wavemender's Mantle is an epic mail shoulder armor for shaman.
The Ward of Wakening is the second of the Druid's quest chain.
The Warchief's Mandate sends the player to ask for help in determining the origins of the strange axe.
This quest directs the character from Bloodmyst Isle to Darkshore, where further quests can be found.

The Vile Reef is a Horde-only quest in Stranglethorn Vale in which players must dive off the coast near Grom'gol Base Camp to collect a piece of an ancient troll tablet, which the trolls of Orgrimmar wish to have for remembrance.
The Warden's Key allows you to open Captain Tyralius's Prison to release Tyralius.

This quest concludes the Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Players must also complete the Green Scepter Shard and Red Scepter Shard forks before will offer the conclusion of the quest chain, The Might of Kalimdor.
The Wanderer's Cover is a leather head armor. It gives bonuses to agility and stamina.
Completing this quest makes several others available, though they are not a thematic chain.
From this innocuous introduction to the Bloodspore Plains, the Horde player becomes embroiled in a military gambit against the Gammothran magnataur.
The Violet Hold Key was once required for players to open the gate to the Violet Hold.

The Winter Veil Gourmet is related to the seasonal world event, the Feast of Winter Veil. Completing this achievement is a criterium for the meta achievement Merrymaker. This achievement requires the player to have the Cooking skill and be able to cook the recipes.

The Warning is the opening cinematic for the Scourge of Lordaeron campaign. The short movie features a meeting of the Alliance council with King Terenas, they discussed about Lordaeron's problems like the orc uprising in southern Lordaeron and the mysterious plague, then The Last Guardian, Medivh, appears before the Alliance council. Medivh tries to warn King Terenas about the coming of the Legion and the Scourge, but the king didn't pay any heed to his warnings and told him that they were the ones that should choose what's best to protect themselves. Medivh then said that he will find another who will heed his warning and that, now, their fate is their own.

__NOTOC__ The Windrunner is a Forsaken battleship, and the flagship of the Windrunner Fleet, which is located off the Derelict Strand in the Howling Fjord. It is under attack by North Fleet Marines. It is named after the Forsaken queen, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
The Warlord's Terrace is a room just past the Hall of Departure in Drak'Tharon Keep. Trollgore can be found here. File:Drak Theron - Circular Room.jpg
The Wreckage of Lordaeron is an interlude in the Orcish campaign, The Invasion of Kalimdor.
The Winds of the North is an achievement gained by getting with the Alliance Vanguard / Horde Expedition.
The Winds of War is the 19th installment of the World of Warcraft comic.

The War Effort is a short story featured on the official site telling the efforts of a dwarven fisherman to get supplies for the War Effort.
The Witching Grimoire is a reward from the quest Banshee's Revenge
The Wyrmrest Accord is an achievement gained by getting with the Wyrmrest Accord.
The Wolf is a wolf and part of a story (vision) told by Shin Stonepillar in Durotar.
The Warden is a stone guardian located in the Tomb of the Watchers in the Badlands.
The Writ of History is located in Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.
The Vortex is an air elemental affiliated with the Earthen Ring. He, along with Core, Arctanus, and Stikwad / Sabina Pilgrim, attempt to deal with Lord Magmathar at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.

The Wandering Widow is a wood-panel scroll leaning against a shrine, which features a small statue of riding found at north west of the Meeting Stone for Stormstout Brewery, at Thirsty Alley in southwestern Valley of the Four Winds. Interacting with the scroll is a requirement of the Pandaria exploration achievement Ballad of Liu Lang. After Chen Stormstout and Li Li Stormstout were assisted by adventurers in clearing out the mess in Stormstout Brewery, they got to know Uncle Gao, who showed them the shrine to the pair's direct ancestors.
The Water of Youth can be found at the Pools of Youth in Krasarang Wilds after defeating Groundbreaker Brojai's Sleeping Guardians.

The Warlord and the Monk is a tome found in various places on Pandaria, including: *on the south side of the upper level of the Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. *Master Windfur's house in Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.
The World Famous Ring of Blood! involves killing five opponents in the Ring of Blood and spawns Mogor's Cache, containing gold, Apexis Crystals, and follower upgrade tokens.

The War is an ongoing conflict between Blingtron units led by (0x0002), and an unknown threat led by something calling itself iR-T0. The War is mainly fought in the caves of the Magnetic Chasm, below the Molten Eternium Sea, but agents of iR-T0 have also managed to secure a foothold on Azeroth. It is possible to uncover cryptic messages describing the conflict through the decoded messages obtained from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Packages or encrypted messages from the Blingtron 7000 Gift Packages. The Blingtrons seek to keep "organic awareness" of The War to a minimum, leading them to increase generosity circuits in all Blingtron units, an effort referred to as "The Facade". Despite these effor

The Wardens are night elven wardens loyal to Maiev Shadowsong operating in the Broken Isles. They have worked from their base of operations, the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna, to hunt down and neutralize major threats to Azeroth's inhabitants, through imprisonment or summary execution. Captured foes were interned in the Vault of the Wardens. They reward the heroes who help them deal with dangerous threats on the Broken Isles. The faction is known to possess Warden Towers across the Broken Isles, although in recent times they have been forced to abandon many of them. There are two in most Legion zones that serve as PvP targets.
The Woolomancer's Charge unlocks Woolomancer's Charge appearance for the Aluneth artifact.
The Warmace of Shirvallah unlocks the Zandalar Champion appearance for the Doomhammer (artifact) artifact.
The Winterskorn War was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion. However, it was removed prior to release.
During the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, this book was available as an item. However, it was removed prior to release.
The Widow can be found at the Black Market in the Dalaran sewer. With a Widowsister Contract, one can hire the help of her Widowsisters.
The World Awaits is a special quest that is only available during the World Quests bonus event.

:"I am the Voraxx. I speak for the weeds." :— Flavor text The Voraxx is a voracious, carnivorous plant native to Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone. The name "Voraxx" was given to it by the tortollans, who try to avoid it.

The World of Warcraft Townhall is a source of Warcraft lore. It served as the first official page explaining the world, lore and game mechanics of the game. Formerly located at http://www.blizzard.com/wow/townhall/, it did not survive the official site overhaul of the World of Warcraft Official Website. Online transcriptions can be found at [http://web.archive.org/web/20031124092215/http://www.blizzard.com/wow/townhall/ Wayback Machine] and in the articles below.
The Wake of Something New may not always turn up a good thing.

The Warchief Awaits begins the War of the Thorns world event from the Horde perspective. This quest is offered automatically on login to players who have completed the Legion epilogue storyline, at least up through The Blood of Azeroth (Horde).
The Void Lies Sleeping is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating Lord Stormsong in Shrine of the Storm without coming into contact with any Awoken Void on Mythic difficulty.
The Voldunai is a reputation achievement earned for reaching status with the Voldunai.
The Watcher's Hammer appearance is a reward from the Lost Edicts of the Watcher for the The Silver Hand artifact, the item itself is not obtainable.

The Word of Zul II is found in the Temple of the Prophet in Zuldazar.
The Word of Zul I is found in the Temple of the Prophet in Zuldazar.
The World of Warcraft Pop-Up Book is an artbook based on World of Warcraft. It is composed of unique art and the descriptions cover Warcrafts story up to and including Battle for Azeroth.

The Would-Be Queen is a Scarlet Brotherhood propaganda pamphlet located in a stand of trees just southwest of Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades. Three other similar pamphlets are lying in the same location: The Cursed Old Wolf, The Last Menethil, and The Traitor King (item). Looting it requires level .
The Ways of the Old Gods can be found in the Karazhan Catacombs during the On the Trail of the Black Prince.
The World of Warcraft Pop-Up Book Collector's Edition is an artbook based on World of Warcraft.
The Wastewandering Dead is the daily version of Wastewander Hosts.
The Violaceous Pearl drops from Mrrgrl the Tide Reaver in Azsuna.

The Watcher's Divine Inspiration drops from the Ivory Sentinel in Skold-Ashil in Stormheim.
The Wild Hunt is a reputation achievement earned by reaching Exalted status with the Wild Hunt.
The Weak Link fully unlocks the Runecarver in Torghast, Tower of the Damned, and once this quest is complete, memories of the Runecarver will start dropping (or be available for purchase).
The Winter Cycle: A Collection of Ardenweald Etiquettes and Parables...
The Well of Existence is an Azerite Essence obtained through the Rustbolt Resistance reputation faction. This essence can only be used by healer specializations.

.]] The Woof Pack was a bundle of two companions and two mounts that are available at a discount from the Blizzard Shop and the In-Game Store. The bundle was available from 21 December 2020 to 4 January 2021.
The World Beyond is a quest achievement earned by completing 100 different World Quests in the Shadowlands.
The Weight of Stone is a potential daily quest at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

The World Reborn is an official video released by Blizzard. It was the final reward unlocked as part of the "Your Fortune Awaits" promotion at [http://fortune.worldofwarcraft.com fortune.worldofwarcraft.com].
The Way Forward concludes "Forming an Understanding", the third chapter of the Zereth Mortis campaign. The next chapter, "Forging a New Path", begins with News from Oribos.
The Wild Drum is looted from Droman Aliothe's Substantial Tribute, Droman Aliothe's Tribute and Droman Aliothe's Extravagant Tribute.

The Vow Eternal is a short story by Christie Golden released on the official site on November 21, 2022. It features Wrathion as he reflects on his legacy and includes the wedding between Lor'themar Theron and Thalyssra.

The War Creche is a world quest taking place in the War Creche and the Earth-Warder's Cauldron of the Old Weyrn Grounds in southern Forbidden Reach. The quest marker appears at , but the enemies to kill are further south in the range.

Thelsamar is a dwarven town on the west side of Loch Modan, located north of Grizzlepaw Ridge and northeast of Stonesplinter Valley. The town has a gryphon roost, an inn, and several vendors and profession trainers. A north-south road runs just west of town, leading to the passes into Dun Morogh and the Wetlands.

Thick Leather can be from skinning level 40-50 mobs. Reliable sources include: *Level 45+: Nyxondra's Broodlings in Badlands, with a 77% drop rate. They are only a few feet apart from each other and they will respawn before you clear the area. *Level 47+: Ravasaurs in Un'Goro Crater. They drop the same amount of Thick Leather as the whelps in Badlands, but they are far from each other and it's a bit harder to kill them.
__NOTOC__ Thick Hide is obtained from skinning level 40-60 skinnable beasts.

Therazane the Stonemother is the Elemental Lord of earth, and formerly one of the Old Gods' lieutenants. As the ruler of Deepholm and mother of the mighty Stone Lords, she is the master of all earth elementals. She takes the form of a massive female figure made of brown rocks and violet gemstones that are always seen floating just above the ground. Despite her general disinterest in mortal affairs, Therazane has worked with the mortals of Azeroth several times against the Old Gods' forces, having shown nothing but contempt for her former masters and their servants. She also rallied her forces to aid the Earthen Ring during the third invasion of the Burning Legion.

__NOTOC__ Theka the Martyr is an elite undead sand troll mini-boss found in Zul'Farrak. A historical figure in Sandfury society who sacrificed himself for the benefit of his people, those who persecuted him were forever cursed into the form of scarabs. Yeh'kinya wants the tablet that Theka possesses.

In spite of Thrall's orders that the humans of Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh are to be left alone, a clandestine war rages on in the region. Nazeer Bloodpike, the local spymaster, has recently recruited volunteers to discreetly eliminate some of Theramore infilitrators that have taken up positions to the east of Brackenwall Village in order to effectively spy on the settlement. Although a number of these infilitrators have been assassinated, it is unknown how many are still performing their duty from the cover of shadows. The presence of Theramore infiltrators in the vicinity of Brackenwall village indicates that the understanding between Jaina Proudmoore and Thrall has probably run its
The Thick Leather Ammo Pouch was created with Leatherworking (225); taught by trainers.

Thero'shan or thero-shan is a courtesy title of great respect meaning "honored student" in Darnassian, the language of the night elves. It is the title by which Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage is addressed by the demigod Cenarius, and is used by Malfurion when referring to his druids. The complementary honorific is shan'do ("honored teacher").
Thessala Hydras are hydras found near Earth Song Falls in Maraudon.
Therzok was an orc quest giver located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Rokar Bladeshadow was his former employee.
Thekal's Grasp drops from High Priest Thekal in Zul'Gurub. It has a very low (3% - 14%) drop chance.
Therazane's Link is an epic mail belt featuring stats which appeal to hunters, shamans, paladins, and even warriors.

Theorycraft is the attempt to mathematically analyze game mechanics in order to gain a better understanding of the inner workings of the game. The term originated in the Starcraft community as composite colloquialism between the name Starcraft and Game Theory. For clarification, Game Theory is the analysis of circumstantial and general factors in order to understand the decision making process of individualized and group players for the purposes of creating generally more favorable predictions, behaviors, and overall outcomes.
Therylune was a dryad quest giver located in the Master's Glaive in Darkshore.
Thelgrum Stonehammer was a level 30 mining vendor located in Auberdine in the night elven zone of Darkshore. He was presumably killed in the Cataclysm, and is nowhere to be found.
Therysil is a dryad located at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. She is missing since the Cataclysm.

A Theramore Guard Badge can be found in the ruins of the Shady Rest Inn in Dustwallow Marsh. It displays the Theramore's insignia, a gold anchor on a white background. The name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe" is embossed below the insignia.

__NOTOC__ Thick Clefthoof Leather is skinned from the clefthooves in Nagrand and from elekks at Ruins of Baa'ri. It can be combined with skinning from Patch of Thick Clefthoof Leather. It can also be crafted with Outland Leatherworking (1); taught by trainers.
Theodore Mont Claire is a Forsaken stable master located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Theramore Sentries are high elf and human guards located in and around North Point Tower in Dustwallow Marsh. Two sentries at North Point Tower assisted Private Hendel in combat when he was accused of aiding the Defias Brotherhood in the kidnapping of King Varian Wrynn. They escaped when Lady Jaina Proudmoore and her retinue arrived to take Hendel in custody.
__NOTOC__ Theramore Infiltrators are high elf and human stealthed infiltrators from Theramore located in a wide circle around Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
__NOTOC__ Theramore Lieutenants are humans located at various points around Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Theldurin the Lost is a dwarf quest giver located at the southwest end of the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands.

__NOTOC__ Theras is a demon hunter at the Ruins of Karabor. He is one of three night elf demon hunters in charge of training blood elf demon hunter recruits. His fellow demon hunter Kayn Sunfury mourns his passing and holds Altruis the Sufferer responsible for his death.
Thick Dawnstone is a gem crafted by Jewelcrafting, requiring a minimum skill of 350. ;Reagents: * 1x Dawnstone The recipe for this item is a world drop.
Thiah Redmane is a tauren quest giver located at Cenarion Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.

__NOTOC__ Theloria Shadecloak is a high elf quest giver located at the Allerian Post in Terokkar Forest. She regrets the decisions made by her former people while she was in Outland, and cannot believe her former Farstrider brethren allied with Kael'thas Sunstrider. She has clearly declared she will not return home even though she dreamt of this for 20 years, stating that the Forest is her last home now.
Thermotastic Egg Timer is a quest reward from Rescue OOX-17/TN!.
This quest is part of the Hero of the Mag'har quest chain and is the final quest in the chain as of patch 4.0.1. It awards Insignia of the Mag'hari Hero and also triggers the chains final cut scene.
Thick Bronze Darts are created with Blacksmithing (100); taught by trainers.
There Can Be Only One Response sends the adventurer to kill the Razaan's Landing's leader and retreive the Mok'Nathal souls he stole.
There's No Explanation for Fashion when people want to start wearing bug parts for clothes.

Thick Draenic Pants are created with Leatherworking (315); taught by trainers.

Thermaplugg's Safe Combination drops from Mekgineer Thermaplugg in Gnomeregan.

Theresa is an experiment of Gerard Abernathy who removed parts of her brain and stimulated other parts. She delivers items between Father Lankester and Gerard Abernathy. She also speaks Gutterspeak.
Theramore Deserters are humans that were once members within Theramore Guard. They deserted their positions and attack anyone they see fit.
Thermaplugg's Safe is located in Gnomeregan. Requires Thermaplugg's Safe Combination to open.
Thick Bark Buckler is a quest reward from Attack on Camp Narache.

Thiassi the Lightning Bringer is the brother of the king of storm giants, Gymer. After his conversion into an undead flesh giant, he lured his brother into a trap. Antiok, grand necrolord of the Scourge, rides upon his shoulder.
Thel'zan's Phylactery appears after killing Icestorm in the Dragonblight. It is also provided for the quest Finality (quest).

The Theramore Guard was the military that guarded Theramore Isle. They were among the finest groups of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor and it was their duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance. With footmen numbering in the hundreds, Theramore's military additionally counted its own navy, and also made use of airships rented from the goblins, cannons, ballistae and siege engines.
Thick Autumn's Glow is created with Jewelcrafting (450). It is taught by Design: Thick Autumn's Glow. The design for this item is dropped by Cyanigosa in Heroic Violet Hold.

There's Gold In That There Fountain is an achievement that requires to fish a range of gold coins from Dalaran's Fountain. You gain the buff "Lucky" by throwing one of the gold coins in the fountain in Dalaran.

Thick King's Amber is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. It requires a minimum skill of 450 and a Simple Grinder. ; Materials required: :1x King's Amber The recipe taught by Design: Thick King's Amber, sold by Timothy Jones in Dalaran for 4 Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.
Thick Bear Fur drops from Young Black Bears and Ice Claw Bear in Dun Morogh.
They're Coming Out of the Walls (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating 9 Guardians of Yogg-Saron within 12 seconds on 10-player mode.
Therapeutic Cloak is an -quality quest reward from Therapy in Grizzly Hills.
Thick Fur Clothing Scraps are a world drop from level 64-80 mobs in Northrend.

Thelsamar Breastplate is a quest reward from Gathering Idols.
The Thick Embalming Fluid is found on a table in the Shadow Grave in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Therisa Sallow is a Forsaken profession trainer located at the Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades.
The Thelgen Seismic Record can be obtained from the Thelgen Seismograph, found at the bottom of the cave in Thelgen Rock of the Wetlands.
Thick Hide Pack is sold by numerous innkeepers and general goods vendors throughout the world.
The heroic version of Theresa's Booklight was never made available, but would presumably have dropped from trash mobs in the heroic version of Blackwing Descent.
Theralion's Mirror drops from Valiona and Theralion in the Bastion of Twilight.
Thelaron Direneedle is a quest giver located at Chiselgrip in the Burning Steppes.

Theramore Combat Dummy is an attackable mechanical with a health of 1. Unlike the dummies in starting areas it cannot be damaged, and is therefore good for practicing spell rotations, etc. by characters below level 60.
They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies. is the 1st quest in the Harpy Raiders quest chain.

__NOTOC__ Theresa Barkskin is an elite worgen found in the Molten Front. When first discovered, she can be seen resting near the graveyard at Malfurion's Breach, but later gets into the action at Igneous Depths during Enduring the Heat. Upon completing the achievement Legacy of Leyara, she finds a Smoke-Stained Locket and mails it to you unknowing the true owner.

The runes of warding are a set of runes found inside Molten Core. There is seven of them in total, each having its own name, and seem to somehow protect Ragnaros who is sleeping in his lair. They are the key to summoning Ragnaros as a boss. Notice that the name "the runes of warding" is mentioned only once (by Majordomo Executus).

Thermal Vents are found in the Molten Front of Firelands, more specifically in the Igneous Depths, Fireplume Peak and the Molten Flow. They are usually found near some ledge. Therazane's Seal is a quest reward from Audience with the Stonemother
The Thelgen Seismograph is found at the bottom of the cave in Thelgen Rock of the Wetlands.

Thera'brin was the first Highborne gone missing and the first being murdered. When Var'dyn Skyseeker learned this, he swore to avenge Thera'brin's death. It was later revealed that Maiev Shadowsong and her Watchers were the ones responsible for his death, unable to forgive the Highborne for their transgressions in the War of the Ancients long ago.
Theramore's Fall is a scenario in World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. At level 90, the scenario can be started via the Dungeon Finder.
Theradrim Guardians are earth elementals located in Maraudon.
Theradrim Shardlings are earth elementals located in Maraudon where they can be found patrolling along with Theradrim Guardians.

Themajicman is the Guild Master of Knight Stalkers on Aggramar, which was renamed to "Blizzard Mentor Horde" when the guild joined the Guild Mentoring Program on August 30, 2012. Themajicman became an MVP on September 6, 2012.
Theramore Arcanist's Hat was rarely contained within the Spoils of Theramore loot bag acquired upon completing the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Thermal Anvil is an engineering item. Using it places a Thermal Anvil, which can be used by players as both an anvil and a forge.

They're Both Footballs? is an achievement earned during the 2012 Feast of Winter Veil‎ when The Pigskin and Special Edition Foot Ball are looted from the Winter Veil Gift. The achievement-criteria items can still rarely be found in the Stolen Present. A purchasable version of The Pigskin and the Foot Ball were added in patch 5.4.0 to toy vendors for , but acquiring those versions (though they can be added to the Toy Box), will not award achievement credit.

These Mogu Have Gotta Go-gu is an achievement awarded for summoning and defeating three named mogu, whose gravestones can be found on the surface of the Court of Bones. See their respective articles for more information. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.

The Zandalari Prophecy is an exploration achievement earned for interacting with the lore objects on the Isle of Thunder the tale of the Zandalari. Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is The Zandalari Prophecy (item), which begins a quest, The Zandalari Prophecy (quest).
The Zandalar Agreement is a banner found at various locations on the Isle of Thunder, serving as another Edict of the Thunder King.
The Yowler is a rare hozen that appears in Townlong Steppes. He is a Pandarian champion.
Theramore Gryphons are gryphons found in the Theramore's Fall scenario, handled by Baldruc.

They Burn, Burn, Burn is an achievement earned from jumping over 5 of the fiery rings within 5 seconds during the Archmage Sol encounter in The Everbloom on Heroic difficulty. In order to get many fiery rings, Parasitic Growth must not be interrupted when Sol is in a fire spell phase.
Theramore Arcanists are humans located in Theramore in the Horde version of the Theramore's Fall scenario.

They Really Love Me! is awarded for having 50 love rays cast on the player simultaneously. Other players must purchase the Manufactured Love Prism for . Earning this achievement will award the True Love Prism toy, a permanent version of the Manufactured Love Prism.
Gazmolf Futzwangler is willing to trade this item for Steamwheedle Preservation Society reputaion.

Theodore is a bear companion of Grif Wildheart accompanying him at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran, Shield's Rest in Stormheim, and the Temple of Storms in the Storm Peaks during the third invasion of the Burning Legion. During the Fourth War, Theodore appeared with his master in the Inventor's Library and the Temple of Storms in the Storm Peaks and in Silithus: The Wound.
Theo the Huntsman is a human located on the edge of Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
__NOTOC__ Theryssia is a rare elite banshee located at Heroes' Rest in Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah. She was once contained by the Wardens.
Then'Ralore was a night elven outpost founded in the lush central wilds of Kalimdor (the area that would later become known as the Barrens) on behest of Queen Azshara. Its fate is unknown.
Therese McLaughlin is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Thel'draz is a nathrezim that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.

They Came From the Sea is the first Court of Farondis quest. These ancient elven ghosts are locked in battle with Naga, and require your assistance before they will help you find the Tidestone of Golganneth.

__NOTOC__ Theramore Deck Hands are humans located in Ratchet's Broken Keel Tavern and Merchant Coast in Northern Barrens. The ones in Ratchet accompany Chief Engineer Foote and attack the Horde adventurers after knocking out Foote during Club Foote.
Theramore's Revenge is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
The best reason to play Paladin was originally a humorous player-made post on the official forums.
There's a Boss In There is a legacy achievement that was rewarded for obtaining an item from a dungeon-type mission, which in turn offered a dungeon quest.
Theramore Marksmen are humans located in Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. They assist in killing Tethyr. They also appear in Theramore's Fall.
Theramore Preservers are humans located at Merchant Coast in the Northern Barrens.
Theramore Sharpshooters are humans located at Merchant Coast in Northern Barrens.
Theramore Skirmishers are humans located in Dustwallow Marsh. They accompanied Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with Paval Reethe and were killed by the Horde adventurers.
Theramore Prisoners are humans located in Blackhoof Village captured by the Grimtotems in Dustwallow Marsh.
Thelbus Wimblenod is a gnome located aboard the Vindicaar on Krokuun.

They See Me Rolling is a hidden quest achievement earned from successfully delivering a Barrel of Storm Brew without taking any damage. It can still be earned even if Rolling Thunder (quest) has been completed.
These Go To Eleven was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 11.
Thick-Trunk was a Draenor ancient located in . It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Theodric's Lodge is the home of Elliot Theodric. The building is located at Dreadwake's Landing in Stormheim.
Thelwater's Steelwoven Eyepatch is a reward from the following quests: *The Gnoll King *Grant Me Revenge
They Eat Like Orcs took place at the Long Wash in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.

Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader is created by using Kul Tiran and Zandalari Engineering; taught by the Kul Tiran and Zandalari engineering trainers, and for at a skill of (1). Rank 2 is taught by the same trainer for at a skill of (35). Rank 3 is taught by Schematic: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader; obtained from World Quest: Work Order: Thermo-Accelerated Plague Spreader.

These Hills Sing is awarded to players who use An Unforgettable Luncheon at at the top of Widow's Peak marked with a rug and pillows above Briarback Kraul and Sprucewood in Stormsong Valley. The peak is most-easily accessible from the southwest. Some specific pointers: *Dismount *Stay standing *Stand on the carpet A Luncheon can be acquired from the Discarded Lunchbox at in Brennadam and (after looting the Lunchbox) from the following vendors: *"Nasty" Buck in Brennadam *Sanya Wraithschilde in Warfang Hold
__NOTOC__ Theurgist Salazae is a Zandalari troll ghost located in Nazmir.

.]] The Theramore deserters are a group of ex-soldiers from the Theramore Guard who deserted their duty for various reasons. Some of them even stayed behind in town to agitate the local population with propaganda denouncing Lady Jaina Proudmoore and encouraging more Theramore guards to join them. The SI:7 agent Calia Hastings fought against them. Others can be found as mobs in the Dustwallow Marsh and were involved in the burning of the Shady Rest Inn and the kidnapping of King Varian Wrynn. Captain Captain Garran Vimes sent Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point and find Paval Reethe.
Theramore Merit Badges drop from Northwatch Recons in the Southern Barrens.
Thex is a jungle troll located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

The Theater of Pain is a location found in central Maldraxxus. One event that frequently takes place here is the Contest of Conquest, a competition between the strongest champions of every Maldraxxus house. Gunn Gorgebone, Scrapper Minoire, and Rencissa the Dynamo are competitors in the Contest. It is surrounded by the Valley of a Thousand Legs and Challenger's Promenade to the southeast, the Forgotten Wounds below Scalpian Ridge to the northeast, the Sepulcher of Knowledge and Blackhound Outpost to the northwest, and the Stabbing Wastes, Wrangler Pit, and Iron Trench to the southwest. The anima conductor point for the Theater is to the northeast. The theater has one entrance for each house:
Thesis Paper Pages were to be an objective for Thesis Statement.
Thick Leather Gauntlets are a quest reward from Forbidden Quilboar Necromancy.
Themelios is a steward located at Cliffs of Respite in Bastion.
Thela Soulsipper is a venthyr located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Zandalari Menu is a profession achievement earned by cooking 10 Zandalari recipes.
Thick Cocoons are cocoons located in Hrun's Barrow in Exile's Reach.
Theryssia's White Gown drops from Theryssia in Heroes' Rest in Val'sharah.
__NOTOC__ Thelonia the Cruel is a Mawsworn kyrian located in Calcis in the Maw during the Escape from the Maw.
Their New Home concludes the week two of the Night Fae Campaign. At Renown (Shadowlands) 8, first achievable the week of December 8, the next chapter unlocks, starting with On De Other Side.
__NOTOC__ Thick Gormhides are skinned from the following gorm at the Gormhive in Ardenweald: *Gorm Secretor *Gorm Egg Tender *Gorm Rampager
Theotar's Note is provided as an objective for An Estate Within the Old Gate.

The sinstone of Theolen Krastinov is found in Revendreth in the northern edge of the eastern point of the Halls of Atonement, next to a graveyard marker, belonging to the human Doctor Theolen Krastinov found in Scholomance.
The Theed's Discount Potion Shop was a Goblin Merchant in the area of Theramore Isle.
They Could Be Anyone concludes the side quest chain of the same name as part of the Chains of Domination campaign.
